method: Independent Python standard-library arithmetic on all 54 traces, all 54 fixed probes, and all 54 final token arrays; no resampling or interpolation.
replica_policy: Registered replica 0 for display; replica 0/1/2 ranges for quantitative claims.
fixed_probe_note: Only readouts at 0,16,32,64,128,192,256,320,384,448,512 exist. There is no fixed-probe readout in 300–310; do not interpolate one.

recommendation.front_figure: Use actual intermediate-protocol replica-0 arrivals at 300–310, with shared D and all six raw losses, plus a separate L-D or paired-gap panel; use distinct colors and markers. Label 10^-3–10^-2 as order of magnitude of average setting-dependent offsets in this protocol, not a universal range or a constant gap.
recommendation.constant_gap_boundary: All 45 registered endpoint token-constant-gap tests fail in each protocol. Time-averaged offsets coexist with step-dependent and token-dependent differences. The result explains large shared raw variation and measured response, not strong RGI.
recommendation.terminal_boundary: Terminal same-batch offsets are mostly 10^-4–10^-3, smaller than the requested visual scale; preserve them in the terminal decomposition figure.
recommendation.variance_explanation: Q2 is half the p0-weighted logit-displacement variance. An exactly c-scaled centered logit displacement gives exactly c^2 Q2. The realized whole-trajectory Q2 high/low ratio must be measured because rate changes alter both displacement directions and accumulated dynamics.
recommendation.aggregation: The 20-step left-column means are presentation aggregation only; do not substitute their std for raw D std and do not change preregistered 64-step analysis metrics.
recommendation.no_independent_shift_fit: Do not redraw measured losses as D plus a fitted constant; a constant-offset schematic must be labeled idealized.
